title: Mask Building Idea
author: Erica Wells
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd3ji8kn
materials: Glue bottom to front. Match up curved edges.

steps.title: Create and Cut Pattern
steps.instruction: Create a pattern and cut out the first set to use for tracing onto felt (approximately 9 x 12 inches), ensuring the shapes fit your face.

steps.title: Assemble Mask Body
steps.instruction: Glue the top piece to the front piece so that it can be tucked under the bottom, gluing along the edges.

steps.title: Install Bottom Beading Wire
steps.instruction: Prepare and attach beading wire to the bottom of the mask.

substeps.instruction: Use pliers to curl the ends.
Glue the wire to the edge of the bottom part of the mask.
Apply glue liberally to the wire curls and allow time to dry.

steps.title: Install Nose Adjustment Wire
steps.instruction: Cut 2 1/2 inches of flat wire and glue it to the front to be used for nose adjustment.

steps.title: Prepare Elastic Straps
steps.instruction: Cut two pieces of elastic, each measuring 12 to 14 inches.

steps.title: Final Assembly
steps.instruction: Tuck the inner front into the mask.

steps.title: Fit and Adjust Mask
steps.instruction: Fit the mask snugly to the face, using the wires to form the shape, applying it similarly to an N95 mask.
